nodes.name: docker-compose.yml
nodes.summary: Defines the local development stack with five services: GPU-backed inference worker, FastAPI resolver, optional GPU offline pipeline, Redis cache, and Postgres with persistent volume.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses NVIDIA device reservations for GPU access and a 'profiles' guard to keep the offline pipeline opt-in.

nodes.name: Dockerfile.inference
nodes.summary: Builds the GPU inference worker container from the PyTorch CUDA 12.1 base image, installs Poetry main dependencies, and launches satira.inference.worker on port 8080.
nodes.languageNotes: Single-stage Dockerfile; relies on Poetry running outside a virtualenv via POETRY_VIRTUALENVS_CREATE=false.

nodes.name: Dockerfile.offline
nodes.summary: Builds the GPU offline pipeline container from the PyTorch CUDA base image and runs the satira.graph.offline_pipeline module for periodic graph embedding refreshes.

nodes.name: Dockerfile.resolver
nodes.summary: Builds the CPU-only context resolver container from python:3.11-slim with libgl/libglib for image processing and serves the FastAPI app via uvicorn on port 8000.

nodes.name: .dockerignore
nodes.summary: Excludes VCS metadata, virtualenvs, caches, build artifacts, tests, notebooks, checkpoints, datasets, and image binaries from Docker build contexts to keep image size small.

nodes.name: .gitkeep
nodes.summary: Empty placeholder file ensuring the k8s directory is tracked in version control.

nodes.name: configmap.yaml
nodes.summary: Kubernetes ConfigMap providing shared environment values (Redis, Postgres, S3 bucket, MLflow URI) to the satira workloads.

nodes.name: context-resolver-hpa.yaml
nodes.summary: HorizontalPodAutoscaler that scales the context-resolver Deployment between 2 and 10 replicas based on 70 percent average CPU utilization.

nodes.name: context-resolver-service.yaml
nodes.summary: ClusterIP Service exposing the context-resolver pods on port 8000 for in-cluster HTTP traffic.

nodes.name: context-resolver.yaml
nodes.summary: Deployment of three context-resolver replicas pinned to m6i.2xlarge nodes, mounting read-only FAISS index and graph-embeddings PVCs with HTTP liveness and readiness probes.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses nodeSelector for instance-type pinning and PVC mounts for shared FAISS / embedding data.

nodes.name: inference-service.yaml
nodes.summary: ClusterIP Service exposing the inference-worker pods on port 8080 for in-cluster HTTP traffic.

nodes.name: inference-worker.yaml
nodes.summary: Deployment of the GPU inference worker on g6.xlarge nodes with NVIDIA GPU requests, batch-size environment variables, and HTTP health probes.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses node tolerations for nvidia.com/gpu taints and pulls REDIS_URL from a separate inference-config ConfigMap.

nodes.name: keda-scaledobject.yaml
nodes.summary: KEDA ScaledObject that scales the inference-worker Deployment from 1 to 20 replicas based on the length of the Redis 'inference-queue' list.

nodes.name: offline-pipeline.yaml
nodes.summary: Kubernetes CronJob running every 15 minutes on GPU spot nodes to refresh graph embeddings via the satira/offline image, with concurrencyPolicy Forbid to prevent overlapping runs.

nodes.name: shared-volumes.yaml
nodes.summary: Two ReadOnlyMany PersistentVolumeClaims (200Gi faiss-index, 100Gi graph-embeddings) shared across context-resolver replicas.

nodes.name: Makefile
nodes.summary: Project task runner exposing install, test (unit/integration/coverage), lint, format, typecheck, run-api, and docker-up/down targets via Poetry-managed tooling.

nodes.name: .env.example
nodes.summary: Template environment file listing the runtime URIs for Redis, Postgres, the S3 artifact bucket, and MLflow tracking server.

nodes.name: pyproject.toml
nodes.summary: Poetry project manifest declaring the satira package layout, ML/serving dependencies (torch, transformers, fastapi, faiss-cpu, easyocr, spacy), dev tooling, and pytest/ruff configuration.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses the 'src' layout via packages = [{include = "satira", from = "src"}] and pins Python ^3.11 with a CUDA-capable torch >=2.2.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Top-level project overview describing Satira as a multimodal satire/misinformation detection engine, with quick-start commands for setup, development, and Docker.

nodes.name: run_tests.sh
nodes.summary: Bash test driver that sequentially runs unit tests, integration tests with timeout, and a coverage report, summarizing pass/fail status and exiting non-zero on any failure.

nodes.name: diagnose_scrapers.py
nodes.summary: Standalone diagnostic script that probes a fixed list of news RSS feeds and reports which ones expose enclosures or media thumbnails for image extraction.

nodes.name: .gitkeep
nodes.summary: Placeholder file ensuring the notebooks directory is tracked in git.

nodes.name: .gitkeep
nodes.summary: Placeholder file ensuring the scripts directory is tracked in git.

nodes.name: build_tier1_dataset.py
nodes.summary: End-to-end Tier-1 dataset builder that scrapes news and satire feeds, ingests HuggingFace datasets, deduplicates, balances sources, verifies labels, and writes train/val/test JSONL splits.
nodes.languageNotes: Mixes synchronous IO with HuggingFace and image download steps; relies heavily on functional helpers organised by stage (scrape -> filter -> dedup -> balance -> split).

nodes.name: evaluate.py
nodes.summary: CLI that loads a trained checkpoint, picks an evaluation device, iterates a chosen dataset in batches, and reports metrics via the training evaluation utilities.

nodes.name: smoke_test_training.py
nodes.summary: Smoke test that runs a tiny mixed-tier training loop end-to-end, asserting projection gradients are healthy and printing a per-step summary table.

nodes.name: train.py
nodes.summary: Primary training entry point that parses arguments, builds datasets, drives the multi-phase trainer, and persists final checkpoints with evaluation summaries.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Top-level package marker that exposes the Satira version string.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Empty package marker for the satira.api subpackage.

nodes.name: app.py
nodes.summary: FastAPI application factory that wires the inference pipeline, classification endpoints, health/metrics routes, and a request-id middleware for production serving.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses `create_app` factory with optional pipeline/pipeline_factory injection so tests can stub out heavyweight model state.

nodes.name: models.py
nodes.summary: Pydantic response schemas for the FastAPI surface: classification, batch, FAISS stats, health, cache, batcher, metrics, and error envelopes.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Centralised pydantic-settings configuration loading model, training, and infrastructure parameters from `SATIRA_*` env vars and a `.env` file.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Empty package marker for the satira.deployment subpackage that houses the staged rollout subsystem.

nodes.name: compatibility.py
nodes.summary: Persistent compatibility matrix that records embedding/feature distribution stats per model and context, computes drift scores, and recommends compatible context versions for a given model.

nodes.name: controller.py
nodes.summary: Staged deployment controller driving a model from shadow through canary stages to production with crash-safe write-ahead state transitions and gate-based promotion/rollback.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a write-ahead pattern with `pending_transition` so that crashes mid-rollout are deterministically resumable from disk.

nodes.name: drift_monitor.py
nodes.summary: Embedding drift monitor that records embeddings, computes structural/marginal/norm shift components, and produces a drift report classified as warning or critical.

nodes.name: feedback.py
nodes.summary: Feedback controller that combines drift signals and moderator feedback into a retraining decision dataclass for the deployment subsystem.

nodes.name: synchronizer.py
nodes.summary: Multi-track synchronizer that coordinates active model and context versions when new contexts arrive or models are promoted, using compatibility checks.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Empty package marker for the satira.graph subpackage that houses the entity/event knowledge-graph subsystem.

nodes.name: batch_resolver.py
nodes.summary: Batch entity resolver that LSH-blocks candidate entities, computes string and embedding similarity, merges duplicates into a graph store, and tracks merges for downstream recompute.

nodes.name: embedding_cache.py
nodes.summary: In-memory graph embedding cache with attention pooling, snapshot/load support, and distribution statistics, plus a versioned snapshot store for persistence.

nodes.name: entity_resolution.py
nodes.summary: Mention normalizer that maps surface-form mentions to canonical graph entity IDs via alias lookup and edit-distance similarity, returning weighted resolution results.

nodes.name: schema.py
nodes.summary: Dataclass schema definitions for graph nodes (entity, source, event, template, content) and edge type enums.

nodes.name: store.py
nodes.summary: In-memory knowledge graph store providing typed add/get/merge operations over schema dataclasses with snapshot/restore serialization.

nodes.name: parse_args
nodes.summary: Constructs the argparse parser for the Tier-1 builder including scrape, filter, balance, dedup, and split flags.

nodes.name: scrape_news
nodes.summary: Scrapes news articles from RSS or GDELT into the target directory honouring dry-run and timespan options.

nodes.name: scrape_satire
nodes.summary: Scrapes satire articles into the target directory.

nodes.name: load_huggingface
nodes.summary: Loads bounded samples from configured HuggingFace satire/news datasets for text-only training examples.

nodes.name: download_images
nodes.summary: Downloads associated images for scraped items into the storage path.

nodes.name: quality_filter
nodes.summary: Filters items by language and minimal text quality heuristics before downstream processing.

nodes.name: dedup_by_url
nodes.summary: Deduplicates items by normalised URL.

nodes.name: dedup_by_title
nodes.summary: Deduplicates items by normalised title using a similarity threshold.

nodes.name: _load_cross_tier_keys
nodes.summary: Loads keys present in other tier datasets so Tier-1 can avoid leakage across tiers.

nodes.name: drop_cross_tier
nodes.summary: Drops items whose keys overlap with the other Tier-2 or Tier-3 datasets to prevent train/eval leakage.

nodes.name: cap_text_only_per_label
nodes.summary: Caps the fraction of text-only items per label to keep the dataset multimodal-balanced.

nodes.name: verify_labels
nodes.summary: Verifies item labels against expected source-label mappings.

nodes.name: enforce_source_balance
nodes.summary: Enforces a maximum per-source fraction in the verified set using a deterministic cap solver and seeded sampling.

nodes.name: stratified_split
nodes.summary: Splits records into stratified train/val/test subsets seeded for reproducibility.

nodes.name: _print_split_stats
nodes.summary: Prints per-split distribution statistics for sanity checking.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Top-level orchestration that chains scraping, ingestion, filtering, dedup, balancing, splitting, and writing of Tier-1 outputs.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Module entry point that parses args, sets up logging, and invokes `run`.

nodes.name: parse_args
nodes.summary: Argparse parser for evaluation: checkpoint path, dataset, batch size, device, output destinations.

nodes.name: pick_device
nodes.summary: Selects a torch device honouring requested override or auto-detection.

nodes.name: load_config_for_checkpoint
nodes.summary: Loads the Settings config that was used to produce a given checkpoint, falling back to a provided path if the checkpoint lacks embedded config.

nodes.name: _iter_eval_batches
nodes.summary: Generator that yields batches from an evaluation dataset with the requested batch size on the chosen device.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Evaluation entry point: loads checkpoint, runs metric computation across the chosen dataset, and writes results.

nodes.name: build_mixed_validation_dataset
nodes.summary: Concatenates trimmed slices of tier 1/2/3 datasets into a small mixed validation set used by the smoke test.

nodes.name: per_projection_grad_norms
nodes.summary: Computes gradient norms for each projection layer in the model for diagnostic logging.

nodes.name: grads_have_nan_or_inf
nodes.summary: Returns whether any model gradient currently contains NaN or Inf values.

nodes.name: format_summary_table
nodes.summary: Formats a per-step training history into a human-readable table.

nodes.name: run_smoke_test
nodes.summary: Runs a tiny end-to-end training loop, asserting projection gradients are healthy and reporting per-step metrics.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Module entry point that delegates to `run_smoke_test`.

nodes.name: parse_args
nodes.summary: Argparse parser for the main training CLI covering config path, epochs, batch size, phase, checkpointing, and overrides.

nodes.name: load_config
nodes.summary: Loads the Settings configuration honouring an optional batch size override.

nodes.name: build_datasets
nodes.summary: Builds the training, validation, and test datasets used by the trainer.

nodes.name: run_training
nodes.summary: Runs the multi-phase trainer for the requested epoch count, optionally forcing a phase, and persists checkpoints to the configured directory.

nodes.name: save_final_checkpoint
nodes.summary: Persists the final trained checkpoint with embedded config, args, and evaluation summary metadata.

nodes.name: evaluation_summary
nodes.summary: Computes a concise post-training evaluation summary used in checkpoint metadata and logs.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Training entry point that wires argument parsing, config loading, dataset construction, training, and final checkpointing together.

nodes.name: create_app
nodes.summary: Factory that constructs the FastAPI app, mounts CORS and request-id middleware, registers classification/health/metrics routes, and binds the inference pipeline lifespan.

nodes.name: RequestIDMiddleware
nodes.summary: Starlette middleware that assigns a stable request id to every request and echoes it on the response header.

nodes.name: ClassificationResponse
nodes.summary: Pydantic response model for a single classification result including probabilities and attention payloads.

nodes.name: BatchClassificationResponse
nodes.summary: Pydantic response model wrapping multiple classification results for batch endpoints.

nodes.name: FAISSIndexStats
nodes.summary: Pydantic stats model describing the FAISS retrieval index state.

nodes.name: HealthResponse
nodes.summary: Pydantic health response describing pipeline readiness and basic service status.

nodes.name: CacheStats
nodes.summary: Pydantic stats model for the inference cache hit/miss counters.

nodes.name: BatcherStats
nodes.summary: Pydantic stats model for the dynamic inference batcher.

nodes.name: MetricsResponse
nodes.summary: Aggregate Pydantic metrics response combining FAISS, cache, and batcher stats.

nodes.name: ErrorResponse
nodes.summary: Pydantic envelope for error responses returned by the API.

nodes.name: Settings
nodes.summary: pydantic-settings configuration aggregating model, training, infrastructure, and class-gate parameters loaded from `SATIRA_*` env vars.

nodes.name: CompatibilityResult
nodes.summary: Dataclass capturing the result of a compatibility check between a model and a context.

nodes.name: CompatibilityMatrix
nodes.summary: Persistent compatibility matrix that registers model and context distribution stats, computes drift scores, persists state to disk, and recommends best-fitting contexts.

nodes.name: _compute_drift_score
nodes.summary: Computes a composite drift score between a training-time stats snapshot and a current stats snapshot.

nodes.name: DeploymentState
nodes.summary: Enum of deployment lifecycle states (shadow, canary_5/25/50, production, rolled_back).

nodes.name: GateDecision
nodes.summary: Dataclass with the action (promote/hold/rollback) and reason emitted by a deployment gate.

nodes.name: DeploymentStateMachine
nodes.summary: Encodes the valid linear state transitions and per-stage minimum dwell times for staged rollouts.

nodes.name: StagedModelDeployment
nodes.summary: Driver that creates deployments, runs gate checks, executes promotions/rollbacks, and persists state with a write-ahead pattern that is crash-safe.

nodes.name: DriftReport
nodes.summary: Dataclass describing the result of a drift computation including component scores and a severity classification.

nodes.name: EmbeddingDriftMonitor
nodes.summary: Monitors embedding distributions over time, computes structural/marginal/norm shifts, classifies drift severity, and supports recalibration.

nodes.name: _structural_shift
nodes.summary: Computes the structural shift component of the drift score using stacked embeddings and the training singular vectors.

nodes.name: RetrainingDecision
nodes.summary: Dataclass conveying the controller's retraining recommendation and rationale.

nodes.name: FeedbackController
nodes.summary: Controller that combines drift signals and moderator feedback to decide whether retraining should be triggered.

nodes.name: MultiTrackSynchronizer
nodes.summary: Coordinates active model and context tracks via the compatibility matrix when new contexts arrive or models are promoted.

nodes.name: BatchResolver
nodes.summary: Batch entity resolver that LSH-blocks candidate entities, scores similarity, and merges duplicates back into the graph store.

nodes.name: MergeTracker
nodes.summary: Tracks recent entity merges so downstream consumers can prioritise embeddings for recompute.

nodes.name: _LSH
nodes.summary: Internal locality-sensitive-hashing helper that produces signatures used for blocking candidate entities.

nodes.name: GraphEmbeddingCache
nodes.summary: In-memory graph embedding cache supporting attention pooling, snapshot/load, distribution stats, and standard mapping operations.

nodes.name: GraphEmbeddingVersionStore
nodes.summary: Versioned on-disk store for graph embedding cache snapshots.

nodes.name: EntityResolutionResult
nodes.summary: Dataclass describing a resolved entity match with similarity weight metadata.

nodes.name: MentionNormalizer
nodes.summary: Normalizer that maps surface mentions to canonical graph entities via alias lookup and edit-distance similarity, hydrating from a graph store.

nodes.name: EntityNode
nodes.summary: Dataclass schema for an entity graph node.

nodes.name: SourceNode
nodes.summary: Dataclass schema for a source graph node (e.g., publisher).

nodes.name: EventNode
nodes.summary: Dataclass schema for an event graph node.

nodes.name: TemplateNode
nodes.summary: Dataclass schema for a template graph node.

nodes.name: ContentNode
nodes.summary: Dataclass schema for a content graph node (article/post).

nodes.name: EdgeType
nodes.summary: Enum of allowed edge types between graph nodes.

nodes.name: GraphStore
nodes.summary: In-memory typed knowledge-graph store with add/get/merge operations across schema dataclasses and snapshot/restore serialization.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Empty package marker for the inference subpackage that hosts the request batcher, context resolver, and end-to-end inference pipeline.

nodes.name: batcher.py
nodes.summary: Async dynamic batcher that coalesces incoming inference requests into a single batched GPU forward pass per cycle, replacing TorchServe so the four-stream input format stays first-class.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses asyncio.Queue + per-request asyncio.Future to fan results back to submitters; a single background task drains the queue under a max-batch / max-wait policy.

nodes.name: context_resolver.py
nodes.summary: Tier-B preprocessor that turns a raw image into the four embedding streams (vision, text, temporal, graph) the engine expects, fanning OCR-derived stages out concurrently so wall-clock latency tracks the slowest stream.

nodes.name: pipeline.py
nodes.summary: Top-level inference pipeline that wires the ContextResolver and DynamicBatcher behind a single async classify() entry point returning a ClassificationResult with probabilities and latency.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Public surface for the data ingestion package, re-exporting scrapers, the HuggingFace loader, the image pipeline, the entity extractor, and the source credibility classifier.

nodes.name: base_scraper.py
nodes.summary: Abstract base class for all Satira scrapers, providing rate limiting, retry/backoff on transient HTTP failures, robots.txt compliance with per-host caching, and the uniform ScrapedItem output record.
nodes.languageNotes: ABC + dataclass output records; async lock around monotonic-clock spacing makes the rate gap correct under asyncio.gather concurrency.

nodes.name: domain_utils.py
nodes.summary: Single chokepoint for source-domain normalization that strips scheme/userinfo/port/path, drops www., rejects malformed inputs, and folds known subdomains into their canonical parent so source-balance counts agree across scrapers.

nodes.name: entity_extraction.py
nodes.summary: spaCy-backed named-entity recognizer that turns scraped content into Content-to-Entity and Content-to-Source edges in the graph store, queueing unresolved mentions for Tier-2 batch resolution.

nodes.name: huggingface_loader.py
nodes.summary: Adapter that pulls pre-labeled satire/sarcasm classification corpora from the HuggingFace Hub and reshapes each row into the same ScrapedItem schema produced by the live RSS scrapers.

nodes.name: image_pipeline.py
nodes.summary: Image download, validation (format/size/dimensions), and content-addressable storage pipeline that turns scraped image URLs into perceptual-hashed bytes on disk for downstream vision training.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses imagehash + SHA-256 filenames so same-image-from-different-source collapses to one file; rotates a pool of browser User-Agents to dodge image CDNs that block default httpx UA.

nodes.name: news_scrapers.py
nodes.summary: Authentic-news scrapers consisting of GDELTScraper (queries the GDELT 2.0 DOC API for bulk records), RSSNewsScraper (feedparser wrapper for major outlets), and a registry that hands them out by name; every record is stamped with label='authentic'.

nodes.name: satire_scrapers.py
nodes.summary: Concrete RSS scrapers for The Onion, Babylon Bee, and Reductress that share a _RSSSatireScraper base; concrete classes only declare feed URL and outlet name, with the base handling parsing and label='satire' stamping.

nodes.name: source_credibility.py
nodes.summary: Three-tier source credibility classifier (curated allowlists, domain heuristics, content-history learning) that emits SATIRE/NEWS/MIXED/UNKNOWN classifications with confidence scores for downstream weighting and ranking.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Empty package marker for the neural model components subpackage (engine, projections, cross-attention, modality dropout, reasoning, classifier).

nodes.name: classifier.py
nodes.summary: Calibrated classification head with an information-bottleneck MLP and a learnable temperature parameter that is optimized post-hoc on a held-out calibration set against NLL.

nodes.name: cross_attention.py
nodes.summary: Bidirectional cross-attention block with explicit contradiction gates that preserves the mismatch signal between text and vision through gated residuals, surfacing what each modality claims that the other does not support.

nodes.name: engine.py
nodes.summary: Top-level four-stream hierarchical fusion model assembling input projections, contrastive cross-attention, structured modality dropout, contextual reasoning, and the calibrated classifier with phase-based freezing for staged training.
nodes.languageNotes: torch.nn.Module composition; get_parameter_groups returns per-stage learning rates (encoders 1e-5, fusion 2e-4, classifier 1e-4) for Phase 3 fine-tuning.

nodes.name: modality_dropout.py
nodes.summary: Structured dropout for temporal and graph context streams that substitutes learned fallback embeddings (not zeros) on dropout, mirroring the cache-miss embeddings the production pipeline returns to avoid train-test mismatch.

nodes.name: projections.py
nodes.summary: Input projection modules for the fusion model: StandardProjection (Linear+LayerNorm+GELU) for stable vision/text/temporal streams and DriftRobustProjection that updates running statistics during inference too, tracking graph-embedding drift between retraining cycles.

nodes.name: reasoning.py
nodes.summary: Transformer-encoder reasoning block that integrates grounded text, grounded vision, temporal embedding, and graph embedding with semantic type embeddings (CLS/temporal/graph/lang-vision) and returns the CLS readout.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Empty package marker for the moderator subsystem covering review-queue management and post-surge correction pipelines.

nodes.name: corrections.py
nodes.summary: Post-surge correction pipeline that applies moderator merge/split/confirm decisions, surgically re-queues content where the graph context contributed materially to the original prediction, and tracks classifications to drive selective re-classification.

nodes.name: review_queue.py
nodes.summary: Priority-scored review queue with agglomerative mention clustering and timeout-based auto-resolution so trending entities bubble to the top during surges and one moderator decision can resolve a cluster of similar mentions.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Empty package marker for the temporal subpackage that hosts the temporal-context retriever consumed by the inference ContextResolver.

nodes.name: InferenceRequest
nodes.summary: Dataclass describing a single inference request carrying the four pre-processed embedding tensors (vision, text, temporal, graph) plus a request id, an asyncio Future for the result, and submission timestamp.

nodes.name: DynamicBatcher
nodes.summary: Background async loop that pulls InferenceRequests from a queue, fills a batch up to max-size or max-wait, runs a single torch.no_grad forward pass, and resolves each request's Future with class probabilities.

nodes.name: ContextResolver
nodes.summary: Preprocessor that runs OCR first, then fans out vision encoding, text encoding, graph context lookup, and temporal retrieval concurrently with a per-task graph timeout and a learned-fallback graph embedding when the lookup is too slow.

nodes.name: _candidate_mentions
nodes.summary: Generates 1- to N-gram candidate mention spans from extracted text using a tokenizing regex, feeding the mention normalizer's lookup pass.

nodes.name: ClassificationResult
nodes.summary: Dataclass returned by the inference pipeline carrying the predicted class, its probability, the full per-class distribution, attention maps, graph confidence, temporal cache-hit flag, and end-to-end latency.

nodes.name: InferencePipeline
nodes.summary: End-to-end orchestrator that wires the ContextResolver and DynamicBatcher behind initialize/classify/shutdown and assembles a ClassificationResult from the model's raw output and per-request latency.

nodes.name: ScrapedItem
nodes.summary: Uniform output record produced by every scraper containing source URL, image URL, title, text, timestamp, normalized source domain, and a metadata escape hatch for source-specific fields.

nodes.name: ScraperStats
nodes.summary: Counters that every scraper bumps over a run: requests sent/succeeded/failed, retries, bytes downloaded, robots-blocked, and items yielded.

nodes.name: BaseScraper
nodes.summary: Abstract base class providing every concrete scraper with polite request spacing, retry-with-backoff on transient HTTP failures, per-host robots.txt compliance, and a uniform fetch/scrape async-iteration contract.

nodes.name: normalize_domain
nodes.summary: Strips scheme/userinfo/port/path from a URL, lowercases, drops www., rejects malformed inputs (including embedded-protocol URLs from HuggingFace corpora), and consolidates known subdomains into their canonical parent.

nodes.name: ExtractedEntity
nodes.summary: Dataclass describing a surface-form entity span pulled from a single document with its text, spaCy label, and character offsets.

nodes.name: EntityExtractor
nodes.summary: Runs spaCy NER over scraped text, normalizes each surface form via the MentionNormalizer, writes Content-to-Entity and Content-to-Source edges to the graph store, and queues unresolved mentions for Tier-2 batch resolution.

nodes.name: HFDatasetSpec
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass describing how to load and adapt one HuggingFace dataset: dataset id, split, label, default source domain, row adapter callable, and optional limit.

nodes.name: HFDatasetLoader
nodes.summary: Loader that streams rows from configured HuggingFace satire/sarcasm datasets, applies per-spec adapter functions to map each row into the ScrapedItem shape, and yields them through the same async iterator interface as live scrapers.

nodes.name: _adapt_sarcasm_news_headline
nodes.summary: Maps a row from the raquiba/Sarcasm_News_Headline corpus into a ScrapedItem, parsing article_link safely (working around embedded-protocol bugs in the dataset) and stamping satire/authentic labels.

nodes.name: _adapt_biddls_onion
nodes.summary: Maps a row from the biddls/Onion_News corpus into a ScrapedItem, splitting the '#~#' header/body separator and stamping satire labels with theonion.com as the default source domain.

nodes.name: ProcessedItem
nodes.summary: Dataclass for an image that has been downloaded, validated, and persisted to disk, carrying the on-disk path, content hash, perceptual hash, dimensions, format, and provenance fields from the originating ScrapedItem.

nodes.name: _DefaultImageFetcher
nodes.summary: Tiny BaseScraper subclass used as the default HTTP fetcher for image bytes, picking up rate-limiting and robots.txt enforcement for free.

nodes.name: ImageDownloader
nodes.summary: Downloads ScrapedItem image URLs, validates format (PNG/JPEG/WebP) and dimensions, computes content + perceptual hashes, and writes content-addressable files to disk so duplicate images across sources collapse to one file.

nodes.name: _build_image_request_headers
nodes.summary: Builds per-request HTTP headers that include a randomly-chosen browser User-Agent and an Accept header listing image MIME types, dodging image CDNs that block the default httpx UA.

nodes.name: GDELTScraper
nodes.summary: Queries the public GDELT 2.0 DOC API across topic queries and time spans, handling URL encoding, response parsing, image upgrades, and yielding ScrapedItem records for bulk authentic-news ingestion without scraping article HTML.

nodes.name: RSSNewsScraper
nodes.summary: Generic feedparser wrapper pre-configured for major outlets (BBC, NPR, Guardian, NYT, Al Jazeera) that yields ScrapedItem records labeled authentic, with image extraction, BBC thumbnail URL upgrades, and bozo-feed handling.

nodes.name: NewsScraperRegistry
nodes.summary: Registry that hands out configured GDELT and RSS news scrapers by name, providing a uniform entry point for the ingest orchestrator to enumerate authentic-news sources.

nodes.name: _RSSSatireScraper
nodes.summary: Shared base class for satire RSS scrapers that handles fetching, feedparser parsing, image extraction, and stamping label='satire' so concrete scrapers only declare the feed URL, outlet name, and source domain.

nodes.name: TheOnionScraper
nodes.summary: Concrete _RSSSatireScraper subclass that scrapes The Onion's RSS feed for satire-labeled training data.

nodes.name: BabylonBeeScraper
nodes.summary: Concrete _RSSSatireScraper subclass that scrapes The Babylon Bee's RSS feed for satire-labeled training data.

nodes.name: ReductressScraper
nodes.summary: Concrete _RSSSatireScraper subclass that scrapes Reductress's RSS feed for satire-labeled training data.

nodes.name: SatireScraperRegistry
nodes.summary: Registry that hands out configured satire RSS scrapers by name (Onion, Bee, Reductress), providing the symmetric counterpart to NewsScraperRegistry for the ingest orchestrator.

nodes.name: _extract_image_url
nodes.summary: Extracts a featured image URL from a feedparser entry, checking media:thumbnail, media:content, enclosures, and falling back to fetching the article HTML for an og:image tag.

nodes.name: SourceClassification
nodes.summary: Dataclass result of the source credibility classifier carrying the assigned category (SATIRE/NEWS/MIXED/UNKNOWN), a confidence score, the deciding tier (curated/heuristic/history), and a human-readable reason.

nodes.name: SourceCredibilityClassifier
nodes.summary: Three-tier classifier that consults curated allowlists first, then domain heuristics (satire keywords, low-cost TLDs, opt-in WHOIS age), then learned per-source content history, returning a SourceClassification with confidence calibrated for thresholding.

nodes.name: CalibratedClassifier
nodes.summary: Classification head with an information-bottleneck MLP (d_model -> d_model/4 -> num_classes) and a learnable temperature parameter divided into logits at inference for post-hoc calibration.

nodes.name: ContrastiveCrossAttention
nodes.summary: Bidirectional cross-attention (text-to-vision and vision-to-text) with sigmoid contradiction gates that propagate the mismatch delta between each modality's original and grounded embedding.

nodes.name: SatireDetectionEngine
nodes.summary: Top-level torch.nn.Module composing input projections, contrastive cross-attention, modality dropout, contextual reasoning, and the calibrated classifier; exposes per-stage learning-rate parameter groups and freeze_for_phase for staged fine-tuning.

nodes.name: StructuredModalityDropout
nodes.summary: Module that drops temporal and graph context streams during training with independent and joint probabilities, substituting learned fallback embeddings (not zeros) so train-time dropout matches production cache-miss embeddings.

nodes.name: StandardProjection
nodes.summary: Stable input projection (Linear -> LayerNorm -> GELU) used for vision, text, and temporal streams whose distributions don't drift between train and inference.

nodes.name: DriftRobustProjection
nodes.summary: Projection that tracks running mean and variance of its inputs during both training and inference, used for graph embeddings whose distribution shifts as new entities and edges appear between retraining cycles.

nodes.name: ContextualReasoningBlock
nodes.summary: Transformer encoder that fuses grounded text, grounded vision, temporal embedding, and graph embedding by prepending a CLS token, adding semantic type embeddings (CLS/temporal/graph/lang-vision), and returning the CLS readout.

nodes.name: CorrectionPipeline
nodes.summary: Applies moderator merge/split/confirm decisions to the entity graph and selectively re-queues content for re-classification when the graph context contributed above threshold and the resulting embedding shift exceeds the delta threshold.

nodes.name: ReviewItem
nodes.summary: Dataclass for a queued ambiguous mention awaiting moderator decision, carrying candidate entities with similarity scores, a priority score, an auto-resolution timestamp, and signals (affected-content count, embedding impact, ingest velocity) used for prioritization.

nodes.name: ReviewCluster
nodes.summary: Dataclass holding a representative ReviewItem, its clustered members, and an aggregate priority so a moderator decision applies to the whole cluster at once.

nodes.name: ReviewQueueManager
nodes.summary: Priority-scored review queue with weighted scoring (affected content, embedding impact, ingest velocity, ambiguity), agglomerative mention clustering, and 30-minute timeout-based auto-resolution that hands deferred items off to the correction pipeline.

nodes.name: index_manager.py
nodes.summary: In-process FAISS vector index manager with hot-reload, write-ahead log streaming, and an LSH-bucketed LRU retriever cache for sub-millisecond temporal news context retrieval.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses RLock-guarded mutation, IVFFlat with adaptive nlist fallback to Flat for small corpora, and pickle-based metadata sidecars.

nodes.name: FAISSIndexManager
nodes.summary: Thread-safe FAISS index wrapper supporting build, search merging main index with WAL, hot-reload of new index versions, and incremental WAL append/merge.

nodes.name: CachedRetriever
nodes.summary: LRU cache keyed by LSH-bucketed query embeddings that wraps FAISSIndexManager.search to achieve high hit rates during trending events.

nodes.name: retriever.py
nodes.summary: Async wrapper around FAISS retrieval that runs in parallel with vision/text encoding, enforces a timeout, and falls back to a learned default embedding when retrieval is too slow.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses asyncio.wait_for + asyncio.to_thread to bridge sync FAISS calls into the async inference pipeline.

nodes.name: TemporalContextRetriever
nodes.summary: Async temporal context retriever that encodes a query, searches the cached FAISS index with a hard timeout, and mean-pools the returned embeddings into a context tensor.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Empty package marker for the training subsystem.

nodes.name: curriculum.py
nodes.summary: Curriculum scheduling utilities: smooth sigmoid-blended tier weighting across epochs and a metric-driven phase transition controller (no fixed epoch cutoffs).

nodes.name: CurriculumScheduler
nodes.summary: Computes per-epoch tier mixing weights using overlapping sigmoid curves to avoid hard distribution cliffs between tier1/tier2/tier3 data.

nodes.name: PhaseTransitionController
nodes.summary: Controller that advances curriculum phases based on loss plateau plus phase-specific signals (projection grad norm, gate activation variance) and exposes per-phase optimizer configs.

nodes.name: evaluation.py
nodes.summary: Comprehensive evaluation harness producing per-class F1/precision/recall/AUROC, expected calibration error, gate activation diagnostics, and attention entropy for the satire detection engine.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements ECE, one-vs-rest AUROC, and normalized attention entropy from scratch in pure PyTorch.

nodes.name: EvalReport
nodes.summary: Structured dataclass holding evaluation metrics with serialization to dict and a human-readable multi-line summary string.

nodes.name: ModelEvaluator
nodes.summary: Runs the model over a dataloader and computes classification, calibration, gate, and attention diagnostics, returning an EvalReport.

nodes.name: losses.py
nodes.summary: Loss function library for the curriculum trainer: focal loss with post-modulation class weighting, supervised contradiction-gate BCE loss, symmetric KL temporal consistency loss, and a phased composer.

nodes.name: focal_loss
nodes.summary: Focal loss implementation that applies class weights AFTER focal modulation to keep the (1-p_t)^gamma factor uncontaminated.

nodes.name: contradiction_gate_loss
nodes.summary: BCE between the per-sample mean of text/vision contradiction gates and class-specific gate targets, replacing L1 sparsity for finer per-class control.

nodes.name: temporal_consistency_loss
nodes.summary: Symmetric KL divergence between predictions on two graph snapshots to penalise over-reliance on a single graph embedding version.

nodes.name: PhasedLossFunction
nodes.summary: nn.Module that composes the appropriate loss for each curriculum phase: CE warm-up, focal+gate in phase 2, and adds temporal consistency in phase 3.

nodes.name: trainer.py
nodes.summary: Drives the 3-phase curriculum training loop: per-epoch curriculum sampling, phase-aware loss, gradient clipping, validation with per-class F1/ECE, checkpointing, and early stopping.

nodes.name: SatireTrainer
nodes.summary: End-to-end trainer that wires the engine, phased loss, curriculum data loader, and phase controller, handling phase transitions, optimizer rebuilds, checkpointing, and early stopping.

tour.title: Project Overview & Setup
tour.description: Start with the README to anchor the mental model: Satira is a multimodal satire and misinformation detection engine that fuses text, image, and graph-based context. The README's quick-start commands (make install, make run-api, make docker-up) map one-to-one onto the layers you will visit next: install pulls the Poetry dependency tree, run-api boots the FastAPI surface in Step 2, and docker-up spins up the inference/resolver/Postgres/Redis stack covered in Step 11. The Makefile is the canonical task runner that turns those one-liners into reproducible developer flows.

tour.title: API Boot: FastAPI Application Factory
tour.description: app.py is the production entry point that the README's `make run-api` target launches. It builds a FastAPI application, instantiates the inference pipeline once at startup, attaches a request-id middleware, and registers the /classify, /health, and /metrics routes. The Pydantic schemas in models.py pin down the wire contract for every endpoint, including the ClassificationResponse that the inference pipeline ultimately fills in. From here, every classification request flows downward into the inference runtime.
tour.languageLesson: FastAPI's application-factory pattern (a build_app() function returning the FastAPI instance) keeps the app object lazy so tests can construct it with stub dependencies. Pydantic-settings loads SATIRA_* env vars and the .env file into a typed Settings object, replacing ad-hoc os.environ access with a single source of truth.

tour.title: Inference Pipeline: The Async Orchestrator
tour.description: pipeline.py is the single async entry point sitting behind the /classify endpoint. It wires the ContextResolver (turn raw image into four embedding streams) to the DynamicBatcher (coalesce concurrent requests into a single GPU forward pass) and returns a ClassificationResult with probabilities and latency. This is the thinnest possible facade over the inference runtime: read it once and you understand the request lifecycle end-to-end. Steps 4 and 5 zoom into its two collaborators.
tour.languageLesson: Python's async/await lets the pipeline overlap I/O-bound context resolution with GPU-bound batched inference without threads. async def classify() is awaited by the FastAPI handler; under the hood, asyncio.gather fan-outs the four resolver streams and awaits the batcher's per-cycle promise.

tour.title: Context Resolution: The Four Streams
tour.description: context_resolver.py is the Tier-B preprocessor that converts a raw image into the four embedding streams (vision, text, temporal, graph) the neural engine consumes. It fans out OCR-derived stages concurrently so wall-clock latency tracks the slowest stream, then leans on the temporal retriever (FAISS-backed news context with timeout fallback), the index_manager (hot-reloadable LSH-bucketed LRU cache), and the embedding_cache (versioned graph entity vectors with attention pooling). These four files form the most tightly coupled cluster in the codebase, with 14 cross-edges between them.

tour.title: Batched Neural Inference
tour.description: Once the four streams are ready, batcher.py coalesces concurrent inference requests into one batched GPU forward pass per cycle, replacing TorchServe so the four-stream input format stays first-class. It calls into engine.py, the top-level fusion model that has the highest fan-in of any code file (12 importers) and the highest fan-out (9 dependencies) - a clear signal it is the architectural keystone. The engine owns staged training freezing; at inference, it just forwards the four streams through projections, cross-attention, reasoning, and the calibrated classifier. The result returns up the stack to the FastAPI response from Step 2.

tour.title: Neural Model Components
tour.description: Below engine.py sit the building blocks that make the multimodal fusion work. projections.py maps each stream into a shared latent space (with a DriftRobustProjection variant that updates running stats at inference too); cross_attention.py is a bidirectional block with explicit contradiction gates that preserves the mismatch signal between text and vision; modality_dropout.py substitutes learned fallback embeddings (not zeros) on dropout to mirror the cache-miss embeddings production returns; reasoning.py runs a transformer encoder over the fused representation; classifier.py is an information-bottleneck head with a learnable temperature parameter for post-hoc calibration. Together they form the neural-models layer, all of them at BFS depth 2 from the training entry point.
tour.languageLesson: PyTorch nn.Module subclasses define learnable layers in __init__ and the computation in forward(). The contradiction-gate trick uses gated residuals (sigmoid-scaled additions) so gradients can flow through the bypass even when the gate closes - critical for preserving cross-modal mismatch signal during the curriculum's later phases.

tour.title: Data Ingestion: Where Training Data Comes From
tour.description: Inference is half the story; the engine's accuracy depends on a continuous data pipeline. base_scraper.py (fan-in of 9) is the abstract base providing rate limiting, retry/backoff, robots.txt compliance, and the uniform ScrapedItem record. news_scrapers.py (GDELT + RSS, label='authentic') and satire_scrapers.py (Onion, Babylon Bee, Reductress, label='satire') are the concrete subclasses. huggingface_loader.py reshapes pre-labeled HF corpora into the same ScrapedItem schema. image_pipeline.py downloads, validates, and content-addresses image bytes. entity_extraction.py runs spaCy NER and writes Content-to-Entity edges into the knowledge graph - the bridge to Step 8.

tour.title: Knowledge Graph: The Memory Layer
tour.description: Everything the engine knows about the world lives in the knowledge graph. schema.py (fan-in 11) defines the dataclass node types (entity, source, event, template, content) and edge enums; store.py (fan-in 11) is the in-memory typed graph with merge semantics and snapshot/restore. entity_resolution.py maps surface-form mentions to canonical entity IDs via aliases and edit distance; batch_resolver.py LSH-blocks candidate entities, deduplicates them, and tracks merges so downstream embeddings can be recomputed. The embedding_cache from Step 4 reads from this graph - this is what makes graph context available at inference time.

tour.title: Training Pipeline: Curriculum & Losses
tour.description: scripts/train.py (the codebase's primary code entry point) parses arguments, builds datasets, and drives trainer.py through three curriculum phases. curriculum.py provides smooth sigmoid-blended tier weighting and a metric-driven phase transition controller (no fixed epoch cutoffs). losses.py composes focal loss with post-modulation class weighting, supervised contradiction-gate BCE, symmetric KL temporal consistency, and a phased composer. evaluation.py produces per-class F1, expected calibration error, gate diagnostics, and attention entropy - the same metrics the deployment subsystem in Step 10 watches for drift.

tour.title: Deployment Lifecycle & Moderator Loop
tour.description: Once a model is trained it doesn't go straight to production. controller.py runs a shadow-canary-production state machine with crash-safe write-ahead state transitions; drift_monitor.py watches embedding distributions and emits warning/critical reports; compatibility.py records per-model embedding stats and recommends compatible context versions; feedback.py fuses drift + moderator signals into a retraining decision. The moderator loop closes the cycle: review_queue.py priority-scores trending mentions and clusters them so one decision resolves many; corrections.py applies merge/split/confirm decisions back to the graph from Step 8 and surgically re-classifies affected content.

tour.title: Containers & Kubernetes: How It Runs in Prod
tour.description: docker-compose.yml is the local five-service stack referenced by `make docker-up`: GPU inference worker, FastAPI resolver, optional GPU offline pipeline, Redis, and Postgres. Three Dockerfiles split the workloads by hardware profile (CUDA inference, CUDA offline graph refresh, CPU resolver). In production those same images run as Kubernetes Deployments: inference-worker.yaml on GPU g6.xlarge nodes scaled by KEDA against Redis queue length (keda-scaledobject.yaml), context-resolver.yaml on CPU m6i.2xlarge nodes scaled by HPA on CPU utilization (context-resolver-hpa.yaml), offline-pipeline.yaml as a 15-minute CronJob refreshing graph embeddings, and shared-volumes.yaml for the read-only FAISS index and graph-embeddings PVCs the resolvers mount.
tour.languageLesson: Multi-stage Docker builds use multiple FROM statements so build-time tooling (Poetry, compilers) never lands in the runtime image. The split between Dockerfile.inference (GPU CUDA base) and Dockerfile.resolver (python:3.11-slim) is deliberate: GPU images are 5-10GB while CPU resolver images stay under 1GB, letting Kubernetes pack many resolver replicas on cheap m6i nodes and keep expensive g6 GPU nodes reserved for the actual inference forward pass.

tour.title: How to Extend: Tests, Scripts & Diagnostics
tour.description: Every subsystem covered above has a test file you can copy as a template: test_inference_integration.py exercises the end-to-end inference path (Steps 3-5), test_context_resolver.py covers the four-stream cluster (Step 4), test_engine.py + test_cross_attention.py + test_classifier.py target the neural models (Step 6), test_news_scrapers.py + test_image_pipeline.py cover ingestion (Step 7), test_graph.py + test_batch_resolver.py cover the knowledge graph (Step 8), and test_drift_monitor.py + test_controller.py cover the deployment loop (Step 10). conftest.py provides shared fixtures. For operator workflows, scripts/build_tier1_dataset.py runs the full ingestion+dedup+balance pipeline, scripts/evaluate.py loads a checkpoint and reports metrics, and scripts/run_tests.sh is the bash driver `make test` invokes.
